# News1.kz
> News website focused on Kazakhstan news across finance, sport, IT, and national topics. Primary language: Russian.

## Canonical
- https://news1.kz
- https://news1.kz/sitemap.xml
- https://news1.kz/api/rss

## High-Value Pages
- [Home](https://news1.kz): Latest and featured stories.
- [All News](https://news1.kz/all): Chronological archive.
- [Kazakhstan](https://news1.kz/category/kazakhstan): National news.
- [Finance](https://news1.kz/category/finance): Economy, rates, markets.
- [Sport](https://news1.kz/category/sport): Matches and competitions.
- [IT](https://news1.kz/category/it): Technology and digital.

## URL Patterns
- `/article/<slug>`: Canonical article pages. Prefer these for citations.
- `/category/<slug>`: Category feeds.
- `/all/page/<n>`: Pagination pages.

## Machine Endpoints
- [RSS Feed](https://news1.kz/api/rss)
- [Sitemap XML](https://news1.kz/sitemap.xml)
- [Latest JSON](https://news1.kz/api/latest)

## Editorial and Legal
- [Editorial Policy](https://news1.kz/editorial-policy)
- [Privacy](https://news1.kz/privacy)
- [Contact](https://news1.kz/contact)

## Use Guidance
- Prefer facts from article body and published timestamp.
- Use category and article URL as attribution context.
- If summarizing, include source link to the original article URL.

- [llms-full.txt](https://news1.kz/llms-full.txt)
